Subject: Proposed redline language & rationale — Elysian MSA (injunctive carveout)

Samira — thanks for the clarity. I've drafted two tidy redline options below (I attached them to DocuSign for tracked review). My suggested default is Option B (NY carveout) only if Redwood accepts limited procedural protections; otherwise we prefer Delaware.

Option A (Delaware governing law / NY injunctive venue carveout):
"Either party may seek interim equitable relief, including injunctive relief and orders to preserve property or data, in any state or federal court of competent jurisdiction; provided that such relief shall be limited to interim relief to preserve the status quo pending resolution of the dispute on the merits under the Arbitration provision. The parties shall use reasonable efforts to provide at least 48 hours' notice to the other party and to engage in a good-faith meet-and-confer prior to seeking such relief, except that notice shall not be required where irreparable harm would result. Any relief granted by a court shall be without prejudice to the arbitrability of the dispute."

Option B (NY governing law / NY courts for interim relief):
"Notwithstanding the Arbitration provision, either party may seek interim equitable relief, including injunctive relief, in the state or federal courts located in New York County, New York, to obtain measures necessary to preserve such party's rights pending resolution of the dispute. The parties agree that such court proceedings shall be limited to interim relief and that the arbitrator shall resolve the merits of any dispute."

Key notes for Elysian procurement / legal:
- We can accept NY for interim relief only if the language preserves arbitration for the merits and includes the 48-hour notice / meet-and-confer mechanics.
- We will not accept an open-ended right to full discovery in emergency proceedings; propose limited, expedited discovery narrowly tailored to the emergency.
- We can agree to JAMS-administered arbitration for merits with a choice of seat (CA or DE) as long as interim relief carveouts are preserved.

I uploaded the redlines here: https://docusign.com/elysian-msaredline-req (tracked changes). Please indicate which Option (A or B) Elysian prefers and whether the 48-hour notice + meet-and-confer is acceptable. If you prefer immediate phone time, I can join a 30-min legal-to-legal call Thursday.

Best,
